parts.title: Task 1
parts.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The line graph below shows the percentage of electricity generated from renewable sources in four countries between 2000 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

meta.preamble:
IELTS ACADEMIC WRITING PRACTICE TEST 12

TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
INSTRUCTIONS TO CANDIDATES: You must answer both Task 1 and Task 2.

parts.title: Task 2
parts.content:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

In order to solve environmental problems, some people believe that individuals should change their lifestyle, while others believe that only national governments can make effective environmental policies.

Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
